Disappointing Experience with Data Synchronization Issues. I have been a premium user of the Wallet app by [MARCA] for over a year, and I am extremely disappointed with the persistent issues I have encountered. Despite having a lifetime subscription, the app has consistently failed to sync data between my iOS device and the web app. Every time I log into my account via the web app on Windows, I am prompted to set a base currency and an initial balance as if I am a new user. This has resulted in the loss of access to my records, which is a significant inconvenience. I have contacted [MARCA] numerous times over the past year, and while they have acknowledged the issue and assured me that their team is working on a fix, there has been no resolution. The support team has repeatedly informed me that the developers are addressing the problem, but the lack of any tangible progress has been frustrating. As a premium user, I expected a higher level of service and functionality. The inability to access my financial records across both platforms has severely impacted my ability to manage my finances effectively. I would not recommend this app to anyone seeking reliable data synchronization between devices.
